blocks.h2: Documenting a Backup for Your Insurance
blocks.body: Take photos and video of the water before cleaning anything, including where it came in. Keep damaged items until your adjuster has seen them or tells you otherwise. Save our invoice and camera footage, since they show the cause. Call your agent early to confirm whether you have sewer backup coverage, because many standard policies don't include it without a rider.

blocks.h2: Sewer Backup Questions From Elmhurst Homeowners

items.q: Why did my basement back up in the storm?
items.preview: Your line or the city sewer was overloaded.
items.answer: Either your line is partly blocked or the city sewer filled up and pushed water back. We clear and scope your line to tell which.

items.q: Do you handle water damage cleanup?
items.preview: We fix the plumbing. A restoration company handles cleanup.
items.answer: We clear the line and repair the cause. For drying and cleanup, a restoration company is the right call.

items.preview: Often only with a sewer backup rider.
items.answer: Many policies need a sewer backup rider. Check with your agent.

items.q: How do I keep it from happening again?
items.answer: Keep the line clean with [sewer maintenance](/elmhurst/sewer-maintenance) and add a backflow valve or overhead sewer if storms are the trigger.

items.q: Will you talk to my insurance adjuster?
items.preview: We'll provide our report and footage.
items.answer: We'll provide our written findings and the footage for your claim.

items.q: How much does sewer backup service cost in Elmhurst?
items.preview: It depends on the cause. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on what caused it and how we reach the line. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
